[Twisted Head Priest's Office]
A swirling green portal takes up the entire back wall of this office, as it spins the air around it seems to bend and distort. The rest of the room seems bare except for smoking torches hung around the walls. Like the candles in the portal room, the flames miraculously burn downward. Papers are scattered across its surface, and an inkwell sits uncorked with a feather quill sitting nearby, it seems as if gravity has no hold over the desk or anything else on the ceiling, including a rug that is an exact color inverted copy of the rug from the Priest's office. [Twisted Head Priest's Office]
A swirling green portal takes up the entire back wall of this office, as it spins the air around it seems to bend and distort. The rest of the room seems bare except for smoking torches hung around the walls. Like the candles in the portal room, the flames miraculously burn downward. Overhead a large oak desk hanging upside-down, hopefully nailed securely in place. Papers are scattered across its surface, and an inkwell sits uncorked with a feather quill sitting nearby, it seems as if gravity has no hold over the desk or anything else on the ceiling, including a rug that is an exact color inverted copy of the rug from the Priest's office. A faint breeze emanates from the portal, scattering loose papers across the oak desk, some of the fragile papers blow off the surface and fall upward toward the roof.

The area is illuminated.

In this room you see: Bjeorn the Galirrim,  Waysai the Galirrim,  Maltrinus the Vorngar,  Maibe the Varanus,  Harru the Galirrim,  Karrl the Galirrim
Obvious exits are: twisting sickly green passage, blackened doorway

[Portal Room]
The world shifts and turns violently and suddenly a small room materializes from the nothingness. The walls of the apparently underground room are rough and natural, and the air is stale and still. The only things of note in this small room are two portals, a red portal that seems to lead back up to the true Cathedral is framed by a pair of ordinary candles in sconces, and a sickly looking green portal that leads further into the depths. The candleholders beside the green portal are hanging on the walls strangely, the candles are facing downward and the flames flicker toward the floor.

The area is illuminated.

In this room you see: Bjeorn the Galirrim,  Waysai the Galirrim,  Maltrinus the Vorngar,  Maibe the Varanus,  Harru the Galirrim,  Karrl the Galirrim
Obvious exits are: twisting sickly green passage, swirling red portal

[Cathedral Entrance]
This building is obviously ancient, the walls are rotten and buckling beneath the weight of the massive arched ceiling above. The floor is covered by a threadbare red carpet, leading to the far end of the building, up a series of steps, and finally ending just before an altar to some god. [Catacombs]
Bones. appearing as if from humanoids. lie scattered about the ground. Some of the bones are side by side and some of them are all alone. The walls of hardened mud sport what appear to be symbols of some sort. Iron candle holders, though devoid of candles, line the walls. A stained ivory altar stands at the center of the room. Iron chains secured tightly to the altar collect mold. A rusted dagger sits center altar impaling it deeply.

The area is illuminated.

In this room you see: 1st vindictive spirit
